finding: No additional own implementation gap identified in the literal service/HTTP and exercised BI-renderer inspection scope.

sourceFacts.scope: AR3 calculation-history and choice-prepared-execution retain and expose exact source/result versions, calculation provenance and authorized receipt boundaries.
AR2 persists nested calculation references and preserves domain receipts/state; the additional live SQLite connection is not labelled a process restart.
R1 assumption divergence exposes declared March versus official May with evidence; application status distinguishes receipt-required/reconciled and refuses restricted receipt values.
B1B observes historical-choice comparison in the real exercised BI renderer with explicit fixture provenance and immutable choice.

limits: Service/HTTP and renderer fixture inspection do not imply installed UI, native/provider session or business-human acceptance.
A revoked source or receipt may correctly make inspection unavailable; inspectability is scoped by current authority.
The BI root retains the explicit pre-existing missing type-only routines/factory reference; package-wide typecheck remains failed.
Original execution SHAs/runs remain attached to facts; final qualification uses the separate candidate-audit.manifest.json.
